name: organization_match_fields
description: RAW organization-match field substrate (AMUX-150 chunk B). Unnormalized columns; normalization and identifier classification (NPI / CLIA / TAX with exact-OID tax matching) live in fhir4ds.matching.entity_extractors.extract_organization_fields. Auditable raw counterpart per FEATURE_NON_CODED_DEDUP.md §3.2.

column.path: identifier.where(system = 'urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.4.2' or system.lower().contains('tax') or system.lower().contains('tin') or system.lower().contains('ein')).value
column.name: tax_id
